arguments.sql:
WITH names AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, s.full_name, a.alignment,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.id) AS name_number
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
    LEFT JOIN main.alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-')
)
SELECT (name_number - 1) / 10 AS batch,
       GROUP_CONCAT(id || ':' || superhero_name || '=' || quote(full_name), ' / ') AS names
FROM (SELECT * FROM names ORDER BY name_number)
GROUP BY batch
ORDER BY batch

arguments.sql:
SELECT CASE
           WHEN s.full_name IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
           WHEN TRIM(s.full_name) IN ('', '-') THEN quote(s.full_name)
           WHEN INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') = 0 THEN 'one token'
           ELSE 'multiple tokens'
       END AS name_format,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 END) AS good,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unknown_alignment
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN main.alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY name_format
